rationale.conceptual: The method is the paper's own decomposition approach, needing genuine understanding of several interacting components: NpT MC simulations, geometric H‑bond classification, Voronoi tessellation for per‑molecule volumes, and the fluctuation method to obtain temperature/pressure derivatives. The mathematics is non‑trivial to translate correctly into code.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has two main sequential stages (run MC simulations and compute derivatives / write CSVs), with standard libraries and straightforward file I/O. No complex orchestration, data fetching, or multi‑tool integration is required.

The method is non‑trivial yet well‑documented, and the pipeline consists of only two sequential steps (simulation then post‑processing) with straightforward I/O.
